select * from (
    select 
        i_manager_id,
        sum(ss_sales_price) as sum_sales,
        avg(sum(ss_sales_price)) over (partition by i_manager_id) as avg_monthly_sales
    from 
        (select * from item where i_category in ('Books','Children','Electronics') and i_class in ('personal','portable','reference','self-help') and i_brand in ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9') union all
         select * from item where i_category in ('Women','Music','Men') and i_class in ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants') and i_brand in ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1')) as filtered_items
    inner join store_sales on filtered_items.i_item_sk = store_sales.ss_item_sk
    inner join date_dim on store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    inner join store on store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    where date_dim.d_month_seq between 1222 and 1233
    group by i_manager_id, date_dim.d_moy
) tmp1
where case when avg_monthly_sales > 0 then abs (sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales else null end > 0.1
order by i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales
limit 100
